items.reason: The Portfolio shows 81 of the 84 legacy positions. Three AAPL rows (qty 1e15 twice, and −50 @ −10) are dropped with no notice (medium). Everything else holds on registered captures: the cockpit, the 81 rows matching (T054 only via HTTP), phase9test listed and loaded, AI Providers state with no values, and the real dir mtime unchanged.

The registered captures show the Diagnostics preview with version and status before any copy (06/07/11) and the "Copied" status after the copy (12/13). raw/clipboard.txt holds the same bundle string with the redacted 300-line log tail, and the key-shape grep finds nothing. Two side defects were found, but neither is the defect this item was filed for.

Clicked-y anchors (04, 05, 08), the Text prompt and gui-check (06, 07) and Lock (10, 11) are all visible and match the read-back. Part 2 holds only on an Ichimoku future timeline. The discriminating panned plain-chart case (time:null plus logical) was not driven because the rig has no pan input.

The terms, welcome, local step, back and skip all hold. The composer lands on Ollama (local)/qwen2.5:7b with no key. With the lane down there is a keyless CTA banner and no error. Not driven: the Cloud and Done onboarding steps, a send on the down lane, and the Local step's Ollama-unreachable state.
